C145.notes: SER SA-CL-001. Obverse Bernardo O’Higgins profile · REPUBLICA DE CHILE · LIBERTADOR B. O’HIGGINS · mint S · user shorthand 50 1996 + photo (denom/date on reverse — Joseph). Mid-90s Santiago pocket change — the Liberator still riding aluminum-bronze through markets and micros while Chile’s copper boom years hummed. Country #22 — first Chile in the vault; first South America after Brazil C047 / SA-BR-001. SER sibling: SA-CO-001. Chile flips now 1.
C145.story: A 1996 50 pesos from Chile. The obverse shows Bernardo O’Higgins profile with REPUBLICA DE CHILE, LIBERTADOR B. O’HIGGINS and the mint mark So (Santiago); the reverse shows value and date in a laurel wreath. Struck in aluminum-nickel bronze.
